title: A counterexample to the curve semistability conjecture for Higgs bundles
summary: In this paper, we give a counterexample to the Bruzzo--Graña Otero conjecture on the curve semistability for Higgs bundles. Let $Σ$ be a very general smooth plane quintic curve and let $X=Σ^{(2)}$ be its second symmetric product. Starting from the tautological bundle $F=\mathcal{O}_Σ(1)^{[2]}$, we construct a rank four Higgs bundle $\mathcal{E}_s=(E_s,θ_s)$ on $X$. Then, for every smooth projective curve $C$ and every morphism $f:C\to X$, the pullback Higgs bundle $f^*\mathcal{E}_s=(f^*E_s,f^*θ_s)$ is semistable.
